programs.organization: Elaaj Bio (wholly owned subsidiary of Loulou Foundation)
programs.delivery: AAV, single dose into cisterna magna (CSF)
programs.stage: Preclinical/manufacturing scale-up with Viralgen; first-in-human planned early 2027; 1-yr main trial + 4-yr extension
programs.key_result: No efficacy data disclosed; CMC/scale-up partnership announced 5 May 2026
programs.changes_decision_because: Disease foundation now owns the lead asset — partnership and patient access run through Loulou.

programs.stage: Preclinical; IND delayed since 2023; no timeline given at 2025 CDKL5 Forum; ~zero public progress in 2026
programs.key_result: Mouse motor/cognitive improvement and correction of hyperexcitability in patient iPSC organoids; stalled on dose/study design optimization
programs.changes_decision_because: Best-funded CDD AAV has stalled on dosing — AAV-dose window is the field's bottleneck, not vector availability.

programs.organization: UC Davis (Fink lab; CIRM-funded; UC case 2026-355-0)
programs.program: Split-dCas9–TET1/activator epigenetic reactivation of silenced CDKL5 allele
programs.target: CDKL5 promoter CGI on inactive X (mutation-agnostic, females)
programs.delivery: Dual-AAV9, ICV/CSF; miniaturized single-vector version in development
programs.stage: Preclinical; manufacturing initiated, tox upcoming (2025 Forum); 2025 preprint
programs.key_result: ICV delivery in Cdkl5 E6del het mice restored protein, re-engaged downstream signaling, rescued motor/cognitive deficits; normalized network activity in patient NSCs/organoids. Earlier work: CDKL5 reactivated to ~60% of active-X level in human neuronal cells
programs.changes_decision_because: Directly validates our target product profile — raise CDKL5 from the patient's non-mutant allele — via a rival modality.

programs.stage: Discontinued; Rett no longer a Stoke disease area as of 2026 (secondary source — verify in Stoke 10-K/Acadia filings before relying on it)
programs.key_result: No preclinical potency data ever published; Acadia moved Rett effort to ACP-2591 (small molecule)
programs.changes_decision_because: Only ASO-upregulation attempt in an X-linked NDD was dropped — do not assume TANGO transfers to CDKL5.

programs.target: SCN1A poison exon (different gene — chemistry/delivery precedent only)
programs.stage: Phase 3 EMPEROR fully enrolled (162 pts, Jun 2026); readout Q3 2027; pre-NDA H2 2026; rolling NDA Q1 2027
programs.key_result: No discontinuations in EMPEROR; elevated CSF protein the main safety finding; 4-yr OLE support
programs.changes_decision_because: Sets the intrathecal pediatric ASO dosing/safety/regulatory template; potency is not transferable.

programs.target: Antisense transcript knockdown to upregulate UBE3A (different gene; mechanism-class precedent)
programs.stage: Phase 3 REVEAL pivotal cohort fully enrolled (136 pts); topline 2H 2027; FDA Breakthrough
programs.key_result: Advanced to Ph3 on protein-upregulation mechanism in a pediatric NDD; endpoints = cognition/communication/sleep domains
programs.changes_decision_because: Proves FDA will take ASO-mediated upregulation in pediatric NDD with non-seizure endpoints.

programs.target: Same mechanism as ION582, different sequence/chemistry
programs.key_result: Reported safe with rapid improvements in cognition, communication, sleep vs natural history
programs.changes_decision_because: Second entrant on one ASO mechanism is viable — being behind Elaaj/Ultragenyx on CDD is not fatal.

programs.stage: Pivotal REVEAL dosing complete (17 pts plateau population; N=33 total across trials), Aug 2026 cutoff
programs.key_result: No severe treatment-related SAEs/DLTs across N=33; multi-domain functional gains deepening through ≥12 months
programs.changes_decision_because: An X-linked NDD IT-AAV will likely read out and file first — sets the efficacy bar our ASO must clear.

programs.stage: High-dose cohort halted by FDA after SAE; trial continues at 1E15 vg
programs.key_result: Treatment-related hyperinflammatory syndrome (HLH-like) at 3E15 vg; low-dose AEs mild and steroid-responsive
programs.changes_decision_because: Hard AAV dose ceiling in this patient population — a redosable CSF ASO has a real safety-differentiation claim.

programs.organization: Apertura Gene Therapy (capsid licensor; 2025 CDKL5 Forum listed Apertura as IV-delivery route for CDD)
programs.program: TfR1 CapX — engineered hTfR1-binding AAV capsid
programs.target: Receptor-mediated BBB crossing (TfR1) for IV CNS delivery
programs.stage: Preclinical/clinic-ready; partner programs entering clinic 2026–2027; non-exclusive academic MTA program open
programs.key_result: Broad brain/spinal-cord distribution at doses ~40-fold below current CNS-targeted AAV
programs.changes_decision_because: TfR1 is now a licensable CNS route — IV competitors may escape the intrathecal-only distribution limit.

programs.program: Igk-TATk-CDKL5 — secretable TAT-fused CDKL5 protein replacement
programs.delivery: AAV-encoded secreted TATk-CDKL5, mosaic Cdkl5 +/- mouse
programs.key_result: Efficacy in mosaic het model; no adverse effects in brain or peripheral organs and no apoptosis in high-CDKL5-mRNA cells — i.e., CDKL5 overexpression well tolerated in the het condition
programs.changes_decision_because: Loosens the upregulation ceiling: modest ASO-driven CDKL5 overshoot looks tolerable, countering duplication-based dosage fears.

programs.program: Engineered U1snRNA rescue of CDKL5 splice mutations
programs.target: CDKL5 canonical splice-site variants (~15% of pathogenic alleles)
programs.stage: Proof-of-concept in cells (transgene context); no in vivo or clinical follow-up found 2025-2026
programs.key_result: Full restoration of CDKL5 protein, localization and kinase activity for +5 splice-site variants; failed for +1 variants
programs.changes_decision_because: Defines the splice-correctable CDKL5 subset and that +1 variants resist splice-based rescue — bounds a variant-specific ASO.

programs.program: Personalized (n-of-1) intrathecal ASOs; no CDKL5 patient program found
programs.stage: 100+ patients advanced, >10 dosed in clinic; >260 doses with no ASO-related SAEs
programs.key_result: Open regulatory/charitable path for variant-specific ASOs; no CDKL5 program disclosed as of the searches run
programs.changes_decision_because: Gives a cheap first-in-human route for a CDKL5 splice-variant ASO and shows that lane is unclaimed.
programs.source: https://www.nlorem.org/n-lorem-foundation-announces-the-50th-nano-rare-patient-receives-personalized-aso-medicine/ ; clinicaltrials.gov n-Lorem single-patient INDs (e.g. NCT07197268, NCT07221760)

programs.organization: UCB / Lundbeck / Praxis / Immedica (symptomatic standard of care)
programs.program: Fenfluramine Ph3 (NCT05064878, positive, AES Dec 2025); bexicaserin DEEp OCEAN Ph3; relutrigine EMERALD Ph3; ganaxolone Ph3 in 6 mo–<2 yr (NCT05249556)
programs.key_result: Seizure endpoint is becoming crowded and background therapy is intensifying; infant trials now enrolling from 6 months
programs.changes_decision_because: Forces a non-seizure primary endpoint and a developmental/early-treatment design, and shifts dosing to infants.

programs.program: CDKL5 gene therapy programs — all discontinued pre-clinical-trial
programs.key_result: Three pharma entrants exited CDD gene therapy before dosing a patient; no technical cause disclosed
programs.changes_decision_because: Pharma has repeatedly failed to make AAV-CDKL5 work — diligence the reason before copying that architecture.
